'''SOC Bothan OPS!''' is a [[Light]] constructed list [[SOC]] published on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]].<ref name="or">[http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/15lite.htm Bothan OPS!], The Outer Rim (SOC). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20091027155334/http://geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/15lite.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

SOC posted this Local Uprising list on The Outer Rim as Bothan OPS!.
